Definition: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally):--foot(-stool).
BiblicalUsage: Pous is the foot, and it walks through the whole Bible. Jesus tells his disciples to shake the dust off their feet against a town that will not hear them, and in the upper room he begins to wash their feet himself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that feet say what words cannot: the Master who washed feet is the Master worth following.
